title: contractStates
responsibility: Derives explicit enum states and guessed prop boundaries, merges state declarations in order, and resolves entity-specific catalog slot names.

inputs.name: contractStates.contract
inputs.description: Validated stored contract containing inputs, outputs, errors, callable operations and snippets.

inputs.name: mergeUnitStates.groups
inputs.description: Ordered state groups to merge; declarations upgrade guesses while preserving first occurrence and distinct reasons.

inputs.name: unitStateName.entity
inputs.description: Exact registered entity identity; a catalog slot prefix for this identity alone can be removed.

inputs.name: unitStateName.state
inputs.description: Exact state or catalog slot to attribute; comparisons remain scoped to the selected entity.

outputs.name: contractStates
outputs.description: Named literal-union declarations and guessed optional-presence, empty, loading, error, disabled and collection boundaries, with reasons.

outputs.name: mergeUnitStates
outputs.description: Stable first-seen states, with REQUIRED taking precedence and all distinct reasons preserved.

outputs.name: unitStateName
outputs.description: State name with only this entity exact catalog prefix removed; its bare prefix or empty string denotes default.
